title: Safe Harness Self-Evolution: A Theoretical Analysis of Feasibility and Limits
abstract: arXiv:2609.08175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Harness self-evolution is the process by which an agent modifies its prompts, tools, code, or orchestration in response to task feedback while keeping the underlying language model frozen, with changes persisting across subsequent tasks. We provide a systematic theoretical analysis of the feasibility and limits of safe harness self-evolution, connecting modification generation, finite-data certification and selection, safe adoption, and behavior after an update. Under a fixed user-task distribution, we establish conditions guaranteeing overall expected-reward improvement while controlling changes on retained tasks, characterize the probability of generating qualified modifications, and derive finite-data bounds for safe selection and adoption. translated_title: 安全的框架自进化：可行性与极限的理论分析
translated_abstract: 框架自进化是指智能体在保持底层语言模型冻结不变的前提下，根据任务反馈修改其提示词、工具、代码或编排方式，且这些修改在后续任务中持续保留的过程。我们对安全框架自进化的可行性与极限进行了系统的理论分析，将修改生成、有限数据认证与选择、安全采纳以及更新后的行为联系起来。在固定的用户-任务分布下，我们建立了在控制对保留任务更改的同时保证整体期望回报提升的条件，刻画了生成合格修改的概率，并推导了安全选择与采纳的有限数据界。我们的分析表明，生成与认证施加的是截然不同的约束：当前任务性能并不能决定生成合格修改的概率，且生成……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文对智能体框架自进化（在冻结底层语言模型的情况下修改提示、工具、代码或编排）的安全可行性与理论极限进行了首个系统性分析，建立了保证期望回报整体提升的条件、刻画了合格修改的生成概率，并推导出有限数据下安全选择与采纳的界。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first systematic theoretical analysis of safe harness self-evolution, establishing conditions for guaranteed expected-reward improvement, characterizing the probability of generating qualified modifications, and deriving finite-data bounds for safe selection and adoption.
